function.arguments: {"index": 4, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The `channel` variable is not randomly assigned — the email campaign was deliberately targeted at loyal and returning customers, who have higher baseline conversion rates. A raw comparison of conversion rates between channels would be confounded by `customer_segment`. To isolate the campaign effect, we computed conversion rates within each `customer_segment` and then computed a weighted average difference, using the segment distribution within each channel as weights. This method adjusts for the imbalance in `customer_segment` and provides a fairer estimate of the campaign effect. The final difference is based on this adjusted method."}
